name: plugin_manager
description: List plugins or bundles in the current profile, enable or disable them, install a bundle, or remove an installed bundle. Every action requires danger-full-access permission or approval for this call. Approval does not change the session permission mode. Changes affect every session in this profile. List first to obtain exact identifiers. Package installation can execute allowed build scripts. Live profiles apply changes immediately, including upgrades of installed packages; a change result that is not applied carries nextStep, which says what to do or tell the user. Unmet DSH version requirements (engines.dsh, else DSH peer dependencies) block installation and activation. Version exemptions risk crashes and data loss: warn the user and obtain explicit permission for the exact plugin and runtime versions before granting one.

target.description: Plugin entry id, bundle package name, or installation spec, according to action. For an Official catalog entry, pass list_bundles installTarget.spec to install_bundle.

enabled.description: Required for set operations; defaults to true for installation. For set_version_exemption, true grants and false revokes.

runtimeVersion.description: For set_version_exemption: exact DSH version from list_version_exemptions. Target must be the manifest package-name@version, not an alias or version range.

acceptRisk.description: For granting an exemption: true only after warning the user about possible crashes and data loss and receiving explicit permission for this exact plugin/runtime pair. General installation permission is not enough.

approvedBuilds.description: For install_bundle: pass names from pendingBuilds only after the user explicitly approves running their install scripts in the conversation. This grants persistent permission for this profile.

registry.description: For install_bundle: the npm registry URL asked first, when the user names one; otherwise the configured registry is asked, and its configured fallbacks while a registry is unreachable.

limit.description: List page size, from 1 to 100; defaults to 25.

ERROR_STEPS.management-required: This entry belongs to plugin management itself and cannot be changed.
ERROR_STEPS.unaddressable: This entry has no unique profile patch target; tell the user to edit the profile patch file directly.
ERROR_STEPS.unknown-plugin: Call list_plugins and retry with an exact entryId.
ERROR_STEPS.invalid-spec: Retry with an npm package name, a git URL, a tarball URL, or an absolute local directory.
ERROR_STEPS.already-installed: The package is already installed; to install another version, call remove_bundle first, then install_bundle again.
ERROR_STEPS.ambiguous-install: The dependency change named no single package; call list_bundles to see what was installed.
ERROR_STEPS.not-bundle: The package declares no dsh.bundle and cannot be managed as a plugin; install a DSH plugin bundle instead.
ERROR_STEPS.not-removable: Call list_bundles; only bundles marked removable can be removed.
ERROR_STEPS.stop-profile: This profile runs without HMR; tell the user to stop DSH and run `dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove <bundle>`.
ERROR_STEPS.bundle-in-use: Call list_plugins, disable the entries from other layers that still use this bundle, then retry.
ERROR_STEPS.stale-approval: Call install_bundle again without approvedBuilds to read the current pendingBuilds.
ERROR_STEPS.incompatible-version: Install a version compatible with the running DSH. A version exemption needs the user's explicit acceptance of crash and data-loss risk.
ERROR_STEPS.unsupported-platform: This bundle cannot run on the current Host platform; ask the user to use a supported Host.
ERROR_STEPS.unexpected-package: The source installed another package or version than requested and was rolled back; report this to the user.
ERROR_STEPS.operation-error: Report the diagnostic to the user; retry only after its cause is addressed.

FAILURE_STEPS.pnpm-missing: pnpm is not available to DSH; tell the user to install pnpm.
FAILURE_STEPS.timeout: Retry, or retry with another registry.
FAILURE_STEPS.not-found: Check the package name and version with the user, then retry.
FAILURE_STEPS.network: Retry later or pass another registry.
FAILURE_STEPS.disk-full: Tell the user to free disk space, then retry.
FAILURE_STEPS.permission: Tell the user DSH cannot write the profile directory; retry after they fix its permissions.
FAILURE_STEPS.build-blocked: Ask the user whether to allow the install scripts of the packages in pendingBuilds; if they approve, retry with approvedBuilds.

RESTART_STEPS.no-hmr: this profile applies changes only at startup
RESTART_STEPS.package-moved: an installed package now resolves to another directory, or the change replaces a package the DSH installation provides; remove a package before installing it from another location
RESTART_STEPS.host-module: the change reaches modules DSH itself loaded
RESTART_STEPS.unmanaged-plugin: the change reaches a plugin running outside the plugin list
RESTART_STEPS.module-comparison: DSH could not compare loaded plugins with their files
